subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Should maintainers accept a bounded close-handler mitigation for the production-observed Discord 1005/1006 dead-lane state, or require a public lifecycle reproduction/root-cause transition before repair?
rationale: The most direct prior PR had strong live proof but was not merged because the manufactured test state did not prove the production transition; automation should not choose that invariant boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require live or harness root-cause proof
options.body: Keep this open until a live Discord run or focused transport harness proves the transition that prevents reconnect, then repair that owner path.

options.title: Accept close-handler mitigation with diagnostics
options.body: Let a narrow PR re-arm abnormal closes at the close handler and promote a diagnostic so future recurrences are visible, accepting that the owner transition remains unidentified.

options.title: Add channel-scoped recovery only
options.body: Expose a Discord provider reconnect action as an operator fallback while leaving automatic recovery for a later root-cause fix.

recommendation.title: Require live or harness root-cause proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a live Discord run or focused transport harness proves the transition that prevents reconnect, then repair that owner path.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent ownership signals across Discord gateway supervision, post-release recovery fixes, and maintainer proof comments in this area.
